title: Buddy Thunderstruck
overview: Follow the outrageous, high-octane adventures of Buddy Thunderstruck, a truck-racing dog who brings guts and good times to the town of Greasepit.

title: Dinotrux: Supercharged
overview: Amped up with powers that make them faster, stronger and more agile than ever, the Dinotrux are back to face new challenges and meet new friends.

title: Fast & Furious Spy Racers
overview: A government agency recruits teen driver Tony Toretto and his thrill-seeking friends to infiltrate a criminal street racing circuit as undercover spies.

title: Go, Dog. Go!
overview: Handy and inventive pup Tag chases adventure with her best pal, Scooch, solving problems and helping the citizens of Pawston along the way.

title: Hot Wheels Let's Race
overview: Six young hopefuls at the Hot Wheels Ultimate Garage Racing Camp learn the skills they need to become the next generation of amazing racers.

title: LEGO City Adventures
overview: Welcome to LEGO City, a modern metropolis filled with the fiercest firefighters, the cream of the crop cops, and so many Blockheads. Every citizen will assemble together for the most awesomely awesome adventures.

title: MaveriX
overview: Six young motocross riders come together to form a team, to make the national titles, or crash out trying. But the biggest win of all might be the friends they make for life.

title: Mighty Express
overview: Catch a ride with the Mighty Express — a team of trains and their kid friends who overcome trouble on the tracks with quick thinking and teamwork!

title: Mighty Express: Train Trouble
overview: A sneaky duo has tricked the trains and taken over Mission Station! Can Flicker flex his skills on the tracks to rescue his friends and save the day?

title: Mighty Monsterwheelies
overview: Inspired by iconic movie monsters like Dracula and the Mummy, but with a Frankenstein-sized twist: These vehicle heroes are here to help — not scare!

title: Robocar Poli
overview: When disaster strikes in Brooms Town, police car Robocar Poli, fire truck Robotruck Roy and their friends on the rescue team race to save the day.

title: Rubble & Crew
overview: Follow Rubble and his pup family as they use their awesome construction vehicles to build and repair whatever the town of Builder Cove needs in high-stakes adventures.

title: Tayo the Little Bus
overview: Tayo the Little Bus is a South Korean computer-generated animated television series created by Educational Broadcasting System, Iconix Entertainment, Seoul and Hot Animation which is owned by HiT Entertainment. The Korean-dubbed series began airing on EBS in 2010 and the English-dubbed series aired on Disney Junior in 2012. The latter is also scheduled to air on Disney Channel and Cartoonito in 2013. The narrator of the UK series is Michael Angelis who also narrates the UK series of Thomas & Friends.

title: The Magic School Bus Rides Again: In the Zone
overview: Ms. Frizzle’s cousin, a pop star, performs worldwide on New Year’s Eve and the class has been invited backstage. When the Bus undergoes a software update during the tour, it starts to glitch and malfunction.

title: Thomas & Friends: All Engines Go!
overview: In a reboot of the classic TV series, a younger Thomas The Tank Engine goes on adventures with all of his friends, as they work on the Island of Sodor.

title: Titipo Titipo
overview: Titipo the train is out to prove that he's got what it takes to help the folks of Train Village ride the rails safely and reliably.
